sections.title: Accepting, declining, or leaving it open
sections.content: A javaslat ("suggestion") deserves a real answer, not just igen or nem. Hungarian has a small toolkit for this: accept it warmly, decline and offer inkább ("rather") something else, or say it genuinely doesn't matter to you with mindegy.

items.spanish: Van egy javaslatom: nézzünk egy filmet.
items.english: I have a suggestion: let's watch a movie.
I accept the suggestion, great idea!

sections.content: Nekem mindegy doesn't reject the suggestion — it hands the choice back to the other person, which is different from a flat nem.
